intro: Government and manufacturing sectors bore the brunt of 21 remote code execution incidents between April 12 and May 4, 2026, with 13 critical and eight high-severity vulnerabilities reported. Threat actor PhantomCore was observed in these attacks, which exploited several high-profile CVEs including CVE-2025-54987, CVE-2026-22679, CVE-2025-0520, CVE-2026-39987, and CVE-2026-22898. The affected regions spanned Asia, China, and Russia, with academia, enterprise, and enterprise software also among the top impacted sectors.
